title: Guidepoint Library Becomes a Governed Source in Gemini Enterprise for Financial Services
summary: Guidepoint announced that a Guidepoint MCP connector brings its vetted expert insight into Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise for Financial Services, making the Guidepoint Library available as a governed source for diligence, market-mapping, and thesis-development workflows. The release describes the Library as 120,000+ curated expert transcripts and primary research drawn from a network of more than two million advisors. Guidepoint CTO and Chief AI Officer Kaushik Deka and Google Cloud Vice President Satish Thomas were quoted.
whyItMatters: Guidepoint's expert content is now reachable from Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini Enterprise, and the stated library size moved from 100,000+ to 120,000+ transcripts in roughly five months.
